Name: Rephidim
Description: One of the stations on Israel's wilderness journey, named in the Numbers 33 itinerary. The camp where water came from the rock and Amalek was defeated while Moses' hands were held up. The name Meribah belongs to the quarrel here, not to a separate place. No further detail is recorded beyond the journey account.
BiblicalSignificance: The wilderness stations trace the route God led Israel from Egypt to the Plains of Moab.
